title: Watch Service History Service Interval Leaderboard
dataSources: Chrono24 listings (`chrono24:listing`), WatchBox service records (`watchbox:service`), wrist-time logs (`watch:wristtime`), and watch service history (`watch:service`).
app: Chrono24 listing snapshots, WatchBox service records, wrist-time wear logs, and in-house service history exports ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=watch:service service_interval_years=*
| stats sum(service_interval_years) as total_value, avg(service_interval_years) as avg_value by reference_number
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks reference values by total and average service interval across watch service history events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `service_interval_years` values for each watch service history event and review total and average service interval by reference.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total service interval.
grandmaExplanation: It produces which reference shows the biggest service interval numbers in your watch service history data.
